name: fts-country-coverage
definition: For each OPEN ALERT_EPISODE future, whether at least one of its iso3 codes appears among the iso3 codes listed in the most recently preserved OCHA/FTS response-plan snapshot (foreknown/snapshots/<latest date>/fts-plans-2026.json, field data[].locations[].iso3). A purely mechanical membership check between two already-committed registers — no funding amount, adequacy, or need judgement is made or implied.
test_rule: On each nightly run, after the registry is folded (practice/src/practice/foreknown/run.py), compute for every future with kind==ALERT_EPISODE and status==OPEN: has_fts_plan_match = bool(set(future.iso3) & fts_plan_iso3_set). Record the boolean per future id. The sensor fires (is worth a note in that night's summary) when the aggregate match rate crosses a round threshold (e.g. below 25% or above 50%) or changes by more than 10 percentage points from the prior recorded night — both thresholds to be set from at least 3 nights of baseline, not from tonight's single sample.
falsification: The sensor is not useful if the match rate stays within a narrow band (say +/-5 points) across many nights regardless of which specific episodes open and close — that would mean the signal is dominated by the fixed set of high-income/non-appeal countries GDACS always reports (see obs-2026-08-08-3) rather than by anything that moves. It is also falsified if OCHA republishes the FTS plan list with a materially different schema (no iso3 field, or locations no longer nested the same way) — the membership check would then need to be rewritten, not just re-tuned.

promotion.why_standing: The check now runs on every nightly run and its value is committed: has_fts_plan_match per open alert episode, plus the aggregate match rate. First measured value, 2026-08-08: 37 of 100 open alert episodes (37%). The sensor stands because it measures, not because it has found anything.
promotion.why_firing_is_deferred: The proposal refuses to set thresholds from a single sample, and that refusal is kept as written: no firing before three nights of baseline. The implementation counts the nights in each reading and arms itself on the third — the machine's own condition enforced in code rather than remembered by a human.
promotion.kept_unchanged: Definition, test rule and falsification are the machine's text and were implemented as written, including the explicit refusal to judge funding adequacy. The money figures built around the check are named plan_requirements_usd and plan_funded_usd in every record because they are the plans' annual totals for every country a plan lists — never sums raised for the hazard.
promotion.note: This axis was proposed by the machine's own discovery pass before any human had built it. The order is recorded on purpose.
